codeReview.summary: The OpenCompass config generator implementation is complete and correct. All required model configurations (OpenAI, Claude, Qwen) are generated with proper types, paths, and environment variable references for API keys. Dataset configurations correctly use PPLInferencer for MMLU and GenInferencer for HellaSwag. Test coverage is 84.8% with 23 passing tests. No API keys are hardcoded - all use env:// references.

summary: The opencompass-config feature passes review. Implementation generates valid MMEngine Python configs for OpenAI (type=OpenAI, path=gpt-4, num_gpus=0), Claude (type=Anthropic), and Qwen (type=DashScope) models with API keys injected via environment variable references. MMLU dataset uses PPLInferencer, HellaSwag uses GenInferencer. All 23 tests pass at 84.8% coverage. No security issues found - API keys are properly referenced via env:// pattern. The feature fulfills all validation assertions: VAL-OC-004 through VAL-OC-008.
